display_title: [Beyond Humanity: Short Stories] What Happens When You Rescue a Baby Dragon
description:
Flora Dain is a noble young lady who dreams of a fairy tale romance. She meets Ion by chance at a party and finds out that he is not human, but she falls for his appearance, which is her style, and asks him out of the blue. However, Ion tells her to “marry me” and takes her to his mansion. Before she knows it, Ion and her have sex, and while they enjoy it, Ion reminds her of the young dragon she saved in the past…?!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*Note: Part of Metatoon's Inoe Danpyeonseon (인외 단편선) Collection.*
